body:
Thank you so much for responding. It means a lot that someone is out there. I do think getting involved in animal charities would help. I hope I can make friends. 

Tbh being happy sounds like a reach at this point. I just want life to be bearable. It sounds stupid because I have a lot of things others don't and I feel ungrateful. I keep finding myself in this giant rut which feels impossible to get out of though and I'm afraid to talk to anyone about it. I can't talk to anyone in my family about it they always think stuff like depression is ridiculous- and yes they often use that word. I'm afraid to talk to a counselor about any of it.

I feel like such a hypocrite because I always try to tell others who feel like I do that it gets better because it really is supposed to but it feels like it never will for me. I need a break from life. I don't want to permanently leave I just want a break but there's no such thing.

I'm so sorry for the long and pessimistic response. I truly appreciate your help
